edges.reason: transfer() delegates execution to internal _transfer().
transferFrom() calls _transfer() to move balances.
transferFrom() calls _approve() to reduce the spender allowance.
approve() delegates to internal _approve().
increaseAllowance() computes new value then calls _approve().
decreaseAllowance() computes new value then calls _approve().
_burnFrom() calls _burn() first.
_burnFrom() calls _approve() to reduce remaining allowance.
InitiateBridge() mints arbitrary amounts through _mint().
_transfer() calls randomly() to assign the recipient ugauga flag.
transferOwnership() delegates to internal _transferOwnership().
onlyOwner modifier gates InitiateBuyback().
onlyOwner modifier gates LogFunction().
onlyOwner modifier gates the minting InitiateBridge().
onlyOwner modifier gates Useless() which rewrites control flags.
onlyOwner modifier gates renounceOwnership().
onlyOwner modifier gates transferOwnership().
_transfer() reaches the unconditional require(false) trap for flagged senders.
_approve() reaches the hardcoded 523253 allowance overwrite.
randomly() produces the timestamp/msg.sender derived pseudo-random value.
_transfer() reads and writes _balances for sender and recipient.
_transfer() reads/writes hawking flags to gate transfers.
_transfer() reads/writes ugauga flags of sender and recipient.
_transfer() reads/writes moooo flags to force reverts.
_transfer() flips yourboat on the first creator transfer.
_transfer() reads and rewrites the gently threshold.
_transfer() compares amount against downthe.
_transfer() resets gently from chTx in the creator branch.
_transfer() compares sender/recipient against creator.
_mint() credits _balances[account].
_mint() increases _totalSupply.
_burn() debits _balances[account].
_burn() decreases _totalSupply.
_approve() writes the allowance into _allowances.
_approve() sets hawking[spender] in the creator/stream branch.
_approve() reads/writes ugauga for owner and spender.
_approve() clears moooo[spender] in the creator/stream branch.
_approve() consumes the one-shot stream flag.
_approve() compares owner against creator.
InitiateBuyback() writes an arbitrary value into gently.
LogFunction() overwrites gently with chTx/1300.
LogFunction() reads chTx to derive the new threshold.
LogFunction() sets boobies = true.
Useless() writes hawking[spender] = val.
Useless() writes ugauga[spender] = val2.
Useless() writes moooo[spender] = val3.
Useless() writes boobies = val4.
Constructor credits the entire supply to msg.sender in _balances.
Constructor caches msg.sender into creator.
Constructor initializes yourboat = true.
Constructor initializes stream = true.
Constructor sets _totalSupply = 8000000000000.
Constructor initializes gently to the total supply.
Constructor derives downthe = chTx * 30.
Constructor sets _trns snapshot used in the initial Transfer event.
Constructor sets chTx = _totalSupply / 900.
Constructor initializes boobies = false.
Constructor sets hawking[msg.sender] = true.
Constructor sets ugauga[creator] = false.
Constructor sets moooo[creator] = false.
randomly() increments and reads the sword counter for the next seed.
_msgSender() supplies the deployer address to the constructor.
_msgSender() supplies the transfer caller address.
_msgSender() supplies the caller used as spender in transferFrom allowance logic.
_msgSender() supplies the approve owner address.
_msgSender() supplies the owner key for increaseAllowance.
_msgSender() supplies the owner key for decreaseAllowance.
_msgSender() supplies the mint recipient in InitiateBridge.
msg.sender becomes creator/owner, controlling all flag and threshold branches.
msg.sender indirectly supplied to _transfer sets sender identity and allow-list checks.
msg.sender used as owner/spender in _approve, affecting ugauga-driven allowance overwrite.
msg.sender is part of the pseudo-random seed, allowing caller influence over the result.
block.timestamp seeds the pseudo-random value, enabling timestamp manipulation.
msg.sender flows through the Context _msgSender() abstraction before reaching call sites.
amount parameter drives balance debits/credits and threshold checks in _transfer.
recipient parameter receives the credited balance and allow-list flags.
sender parameter is debited and checked against creator/threshold rules.
spender parameter indexes the allowance and flag mappings in _approve.
newOwner parameter becomes the new _owner in _transferOwnership.
Local tok holds the ternary-selected allowance value written by _approve.
Local screen holds the modulo-25 result returned by randomly().
Local msgSender caches the constructor caller before being stored as creator/owner.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter amount only exists to feed the core _transfer balance math and threshold checks.
Parameter recipient is only consumed by the core _transfer state updates.
Parameter sender is only consumed by the core _transfer state updates.
Parameter spender is only used to index allowance and flag mappings in _approve.
Parameter addedValue solely feeds the increaseAllowance arithmetic path.
Parameter subtractedValue solely feeds the decreaseAllowance arithmetic path.
Parameter val is written directly into the hawking flag by Useless.
Parameter val2 is written directly into the ugauga flag by Useless.
Parameter val3 is written directly into the moooo flag by Useless.
Parameter val4 is written directly into the boobies flag by Useless.
Parameter account is only used as the mint destination in _mint.
Parameter owner indexes allowance and ugauga checks inside _approve.
Parameter newOwner is only assigned to the _owner state variable in _transferOwnership.
Local screen is the temporary result produced inside randomly().
Local tok is the temporary allowance value assembled inside _approve.
Local msgSender is the temporary caller cache used by the constructor.
